native_result.query: How were the phases of the Middle Neolithic (3400-3000 BCE) and Younger Neolithic (2900-2300 BCE) characterized in terms of the first principal component in a PCA on the forms of capital analyzed in hundred-year time slices?
native_result.HypoA: During the Middle Neolithic (3400-3000 BCE) and Younger Neolithic (2900-2300 BCE), both phases are primarily associated with negative values on the first principal component (PC1). This Principal component analysis (PCA) is on the forms of capital. The values of the individual elements of the forms of capital form the attributes.
native_result.HypoB: Middle Neolithic (3400-3000 BCE) is characterized by peak PC1 on a Neolithic-scope axis dominated by monumental capital (monument size loading 0.584), amber, pottery forms, axes and large house sizes - maximal collective/monumental and prestige investment (mean PC1 +1.61). Younger Neolithic (2900-2300 BCE, group 'SG') shows a marked decline of ~1.6 SD to near-average PC1 (+0.01): monumentality, house size and prestige forms contract while metal-based economic capital is still absent (metal loadings ~0). Direction of change MN->YN is downward. On the full-series PCA (PC1 = 31.8% variance, defined by Bronze-Age metal wealth: copper/gold 0.399, pottery decoration 0.381, hoards 0.343 vs pottery form -0.355), both Neolithic phases sit deeply negative (MN -1.43, YN -1.18, only +0.25 rise), i.e. relative to the whole sequence both phases have low metal/hoard wealth; the full-series and Neolithic-only scopes differ and both readings are reported.
native_result.WorkflowB: Loaded capital.csv (decimal=','), dropped group/color; PCA via SVD on the 12 already-standardized Z-columns; primary scope = all 39 century slices (PC1 31.8% variance), sensitivity scope = Neolithic-only EN+MN+SG 21 slices (PC1 53.8%); sign fixed by positive mean loadings with OBA/YBA-high-positive sanity check (+2.32); extracted per-slice PC1 scores for 3400-3000 (MN) and 2900-2300 (SG/YN) plus phase means and shift; interpreted via loadings; ZSichel (sd 0.54) kept as-is with ~zero loading.
